brief:
The Arab American University in Jenin is hosting a local youth conference on climate change in Palestine, according to Maan Wire. The gathering convenes young Palestinians to discuss environmental challenges and develop coordinated responses to climate issues affecting communities across the region.

The conference represents a significant mobilization of Palestinian youth around climate action. Participants are expected to exchange knowledge on sustainability practices, examine how climate shifts impact local agriculture and water resources, and explore pathways for grassroots environmental advocacy within Palestinian society and governance structures.
title: Arab American University hosts Palestinian youth climate conference
